text:
maria-cs: Hey team — AcmeTravel's onboarding just hit a snag. They were mid-org transfer and their trial credits dropped to 0 during the migration window. Customer says they were running a small load test and now can't complete setup. Tenant: acme-travel (tid: t-84f2). Support ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/12345. Can we do a manual reinstate?

billing-bot: Auto-log: credit_balance_change tenant=acme-travel before=5000 after=0 reason=org_transfer_cleanup ref=evt_98765

leo-support: Oof. Do we have a repro timeline? Was this a double-deduction or expiry? Any API errors in the logs?

maria-cs: Timeline quick: 2026-03-10 14:59 UTC they initiated org transfer -> 15:01 transfer webhook fired -> 15:02 they started load test (small burst) -> 15:03 webhook cleanup job ran and deprovisioned promo flags. Customer saw balance go to 0 at 15:03. No manual spend reported on their side. Snippet from our webhook log:

```
POST /internal/webhooks/tenant-merge 2026-03-10T15:01:12Z 200
emit: tenant-merge-complete -> handler: account_cleanup
handler: account_cleanup invoked at 2026-03-10T15:03:01Z
action: revoke_trial_promo tenant=t-84f2
```

leo-support: Thanks. That looks like a race where cleanup removed promo credits while the load started consuming them. We need billing ledger entries for 15:00-15:05 to confirm token flow. Can ops pull ledger lines and the audit trail?

sam-ops: I can pull ledger, but also check if promo expiry flag was toggled. If the grant was flagged as "auto-reclaim" it could be reclaimed on merge. Maria, can you paste the tenant id and customer email?

maria-cs: tenant id t-84f2, account email onboarding@acmetravel.com. The customer is asking for a 5k refill to complete setup. They were unaware it would be reclaimed during migration.

erin-cs-manager: Policy note — we generally allow one manual trial reinstatement when credits are lost due to platform-side migration within a 7-day window. Need CS owner to confirm and provide the exact amount + short reason for audit. If approved I'll sign off; ops should ensure the grant isn't auto-reclaimed.

leo-support: I can approve 5000 tokens manual grant if CS confirms. I'll need the reason string to add to the audit entry and I'll route to billing team to actually apply.

maria-cs: Confirming request: grant 5000 trial tokens. Reason: "trial credits reclaimed during org transfer webhook race; customer onboarding blocked during load test." Customer will be notified and won't try to re-abuse.

billing-bot: Manual grant queued: tenant=t-84f2 amount=5000 grant_id=g-20260310-55 status=queued

sam-ops: After grant runs, I'll add a reconciliation exception so it doesn't get auto-reclaimed. Admin API we use internally:

```
POST /internal/admin/grants
{ "tenant": "t-84f2", "amount": "5000", "expires": "2026-04-07", "reason": "trial-reinstate-during-migration" }
```

erin-cs-manager: :thumbsup: Good. Maria, please update the support ticket with the grant id and note we're adding a reconciliation exception. Also ask customer to re-run their setup. I'll close the loop after billing confirms applied.

maria-cs: Will do, updating ticket now and pinging customer. Thanks everyone.

billing-bot: Grant applied: grant_id=g-20260310-55 tenant=t-84f2 amount=5000 applied_by=leo-support timestamp=2026-03-10T15:18:40Z

maria-cs: Confirmed in ticket — credits restored and customer resumed onboarding. Leaving note for product: consider making merge cleanup idempotent with respect to active trial grants to avoid races.
